verdict.rationale: FFmpeg's official docs show conversion as a single command (`ffmpeg -i input.mp4 output.avi`), with further one-line examples for bitrate and frame rate, and the CLI is documented at ffmpeg.html. Community users run it from batch-file wrappers and automated pipelines, which corroborates scripted use. Complex commands bring shell-escaping friction. missing for 10: evidence of CI-specific behavior (non-interactive overwrite flags, exit-code semantics), documented guidance on avoiding shell-escaping pitfalls for complex commands in scripts.
